text:
maria: Heads up — opened PR #3128. Small cleanup: standardized a bunch of identifier casing (userID -> user_id in a few helpers) and ran `gofmt -w`. Windows CI is failing with CRLF/LF mismatch. Need a quick review + 1 approval to merge. @alex @sam any preferences on the naming or quick fixes?

alex: Can you paste the CI error output? Also did this change any exported symbols?

maria: Paste of failing chunk:
```
FAIL: /workspace/main/pkg/foo/file.go: CRLF found in file, expected LF
diff --git a/pkg/foo/file.go b/pkg/foo/file.go
- func GetUserId() string {
+ func GetUserID() string {
```
I ran `git config core.autocrlf false` locally which normalized things for me, but CI still flags it. This only touched package-internal helpers, not public API.

sam: Quick nit — Go prefers MixedCaps for exported names, so `GetUserID` is correct for exported. If these are internal, snake_case feels odd for Go identifiers. Can you confirm which style you aimed for?

maria: Right, I intended MixedCaps everywhere; I had a few snake_case helper renames by mistake in earlier commits and then ran `gofmt` which left mixed results. The core issue now is CRLF in a few files.

alex: Easiest path: add a .gitattributes with `* text=auto eol=lf` and then run `git add --renormalize .` to fix line endings, commit, push. I can put that up as a tiny follow-up if you want.

maria: That would be 🙏. I can squash after. Also there's one small leftover formatting change I can include.

ci-bot: build/redwood-ci — linux: passed; windows: failed (CRLF files detected)

alex: I'll open a branch `fix/crlf-normalize` against this PR and push .gitattributes + renormalized files. Will ping here when CI re-runs.

maria: Awesome, thank you. Can we hold merge until 9am PT tomorrow? I'm heading OOO after that and want to monitor post-merge logs. @oncall FYI.

sam: Sounds good — I'll prioritize reviewing once the normalize commit lands.

alex: Done — pushed `fix/crlf-normalize` to branch, CI re-run queued.

ci-bot: build/redwood-ci — windows: passed

maria: :tada: Windows passed. One more ACK and I'll merge (will squash the normalize commit into the PR). @sam can you give a quick look?

sam: LGTM. No functional changes, just style/line endings. Approve.

maria: Merging now. Will monitor console for any regressions and reopen if anything pops up. Thanks all for the quick help!
